title: ANALYSIS
description: analyst -> orch - delegated judgment hand-back. Produced by an analyst agent (owning role for in-domain judgment; a general analyst / Plan agent for cross-cutting or architectural decisions) at ANY stage that needs an evaluated recommendation: propose-solution, lane-map rationale, FINDING option-weighing, fix-loop layer-selection, human-in-the-loop iteration. Distinct from RESEARCH (discovery, carries NO verdict) and REVIEW (role-bar verdict). The orchestrator RATIFIES the recommendation and folds it into decisions[]; it never derives one in its own context. Optional 'role' names the owning role when one produced it. Canonical key order: type, question, evaluated, recommendation, rationale, confidence, risks, refs.
